content_of_post_to_comment: I’m getting a little tired of the “how to prove you wrote your book” articles. I understand they are well meaning, but I have two problems with this premise: At least in the US, the burden of proof is not on the accused, but the accuser. To accuse an author of using AI without proof is slander. Authors, the bullies haven’t changed, they just got a new tactic. Don’t give into the fear. Bullies suck. Ignore them. Listen to the people who love and support you.
